item.title: Whiskers 0.8.67
item.description:
What's new in 0.8.67

### Screen Notes

  • Record your screen with narration and drawings using the new Screen Notes shortcut, Control-Option-N.
  • Turn a session into a numbered contact sheet, key frames, and a text summary you can share with an agent.
  • Paste the contact sheet and summary together with your next Command-V. Terminals receive the summary and frame paths as text.
  • Find notes in History, copy them again, or open their folders in Finder. Choose a storage folder and retention period in Settings.
  • Transcribe narration in one pass across pauses for more natural sentences. Failed transcriptions stay available to retry.
  • Screen images stay on your Mac. When you choose a cloud transcription model, only the narration audio goes to that provider.

    • ### Dictation and models

  • See Live Text while you dictate with local and cloud transcription models.
  • Added Parakeet Unified English, Nemotron 3.5 ASR, Bark 3 Pro, and Underdog Bark 3 Clean as local model choices.
  • New setups default to Parakeet Unified English on English Macs and Parakeet V3 on other Macs.
  • Keep the microphone ready for a chosen time after use so the next dictation starts sooner.
  • Added Settings > Audio controls for lowering other audio and pausing supported browser media while dictating.
  • Treat recordings with no speech as a quiet no-op, with a brief notice instead of an empty History entry.
  • Show a timing breakdown for each dictation in History.

    • ### Reliability and usability

  • Improved recording recovery, storage handling, and microphone reconnection behavior.
  • Fixed applying AI Enhancement retroactively during hold-to-dictate.
  • Improved screen vocabulary recognition, model selection, and cleanup of retired model caches.
  • Improved onboarding, keyboard navigation, and accessibility in Settings and recovery screens.
